name: AI Innovator Student Challenge
timing: Kicks off in November; date to be announced
description: Find a real problem in your community and design an AI-powered solution for it. Teams of up to 3 students. Announced at Meeting 3; ask an officer if you want help finding a team.

name: USA AI Olympiad (USAAIO)
description: A national contest that tests both AI theory and programming: math foundations, machine learning, deep learning with PyTorch, natural language processing, transformers, computer vision, and generative AI. The club is tentatively planning to prepare for it together.
